data.narrative:
Nascent Materials is a seed-stage company operating in Climate & Energy, founded by Chaitanya Sharma. The company has raised $2.3M to date. The valuation comp universe includes one public company (Lanza Tech) and eight private peers in the Climate & Energy sector, including Redwood Materials, QuantumScape, KoBold Metals, Electric Hydrogen, and Enovix.

The stage-progression method is applicable and serves as the primary valuation anchor. Using total capital raised ($2.3M) as a proxy base value and applying a typical 2.5x multiplier for progression from seed to next stage yields an implied valuation of $5.75M. A peer-median approach was not applicable; while eight same-sector comparables exist, none met the threshold of three or more datapoints within the narrow filters of same stage, adjacent stage, or similar valuation tier. Applying an all-sector median would introduce unwarranted noise given the absence of tight seed-stage peer data in this sector.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $5M to $7M, with a median point of $6M. This range reflects the single applicable method and the inherent uncertainty of early-stage valuation with limited peer comparability. Key uncertainties include the absence of direct seed-stage climate tech comparables, nascent market adoption patterns for materials-focused businesses, and capital intensity at subsequent funding rounds. Additional diligence on unit economics and technical differentiation relative to the identified private peer set would strengthen conviction around placement within this range.
